assumptions: Explicit FY2027 GAAP diluted EPS scenario assumptions, split-adjusted for comparison with the 2026-09-18 split-adjusted close. Reported first-half FY2027 GAAP diluted EPS is $4.85 (Q1 $2.39 plus Q2 $2.46) on separately reported diluted-share bases. Thus residual EPS assumptions for Q3+Q4 are $3.15/$5.15/$7.15 in bear/base/bull respectively; this is a constant-share approximation, not addition of actual future diluted EPS. Q3 revenue guidance is $108bn +/-2%, 74% GAAP gross margin +/-50bp and $9.2bn GAAP opex, with no China Data Center compute revenue assumed. Bear tests a material Q3/Q4 demand or mix/margin shortfall and/or multiple compression; base assumes Q3 guidance and continued demand roughly support the residual; bull assumes Q3 at/above guidance plus sustained ramp and a higher multiple. P/E bands 20x/25x/30x are scenario inputs, not observed multiples, fair values, consensus or probabilities.
qualification: All EPS and P/E inputs are analyst assumptions, not observed multiples or consensus. Prices are conditional sensitivities, not forecasts, probabilities or executable quotes. The earnings period differs from the research horizon; assumption and share-basis suitability require review.
